name: Nideggen (Germany)
description: Hanging banner of yellow with a black lion in the upper part and black vertical stripes in the lower part, the figures of the city arms of Nideggen.
history: Municipal flag of Nideggen; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: black stripes in the lower part
